articles.title_cn: 区块链拥堵促进货币竞争
articles.abstract_en: Blockchain capacity constraints induce congestion when many users want to transact at the same time. This paper argues that blockchain capacity constraints, coupled with the need to incentivize miners to maintain blockchain security, lead to low inflation outcomes when cryptocurrencies compete for user demand. If two coins are both used as medium of exchange, a low-inflation coin must experience higher congestion than a high-inflation coin; otherwise demand for the latter is zero. Lowering coin growth rates then boosts transaction demand, limiting the equilibrium inflation rate. However, some gains from trade are not realized due to congestion and the cost of blockchain security. The paper also identifies anti-competitive dynamics in Proof-of-Stake: while higher coin growth reduces transaction-based demand, it may increase demand from validators even more.
articles.abstract_cn: 当许多用户同时想要交易时，区块链的容量限制会导致拥堵。本文认为，区块链的容量限制，加上需要激励矿工维护区块链安全，导致在加密货币竞争用户需求时出现低通胀结果。如果两种硬币都用作交换媒介，低通胀硬币必须经历比高通胀硬币更高的拥堵；否则对后者的需求为零。降低硬币增长率随后会提升交易需求，限制均衡通胀率。然而，由于拥堵和区块链安全的成本，部分贸易收益未能实现。本文还指出了权益证明中的反竞争动态：虽然更高的硬币增长率减少了基于交易的需求，但它可能更大幅度地增加验证者的需求。

articles.title_en: Player strength and effort in contests
articles.title_cn: 竞赛中的选手实力与努力
articles.abstract_en: In competitive settings, disparities in player strength are common. It is intuitively unclear whether a stronger player would opt for larger or smaller effort compared to weaker players. Larger effort could leverage their strength, while lower effort might be justified by their higher probability of winning regardless of effort. We analyze multi-prize contests with three or more heterogeneous players, exploring when stronger players exert larger or lower effort. To rank efforts, it suffices to compare marginal utilities in situations where efforts are equal. Effort ranking depends on differences in hazard rates (which are smaller for stronger players) and reversed hazard rates (which are larger for stronger players). Compared to weaker players, stronger players choose larger effort in winner-takes-all contests and lower effort in loser-gets-nothing contests. Effort rankings can be non-monotonic in contests with several identical prizes, and they depend on the slopes of players’ pdfs in contests with linear prize structure.
articles.abstract_cn: 在竞争环境中，选手实力的差异是常见的。直觉上并不清楚，实力较强的选手相比实力较弱的选手会选择更大还是更小的努力。更大的努力可能利用其优势，而较低的努力可能因其无论努力与否都有较高的获胜概率而合理。我们分析了具有三个或更多异质选手的多奖项竞赛，探讨了何时实力较强的选手会付出更大或更小的努力。要对努力进行排序，只需在努力相等的情况下比较边际效用即可。努力排序取决于风险率（实力较强的选手风险率较小）和逆风险率（实力较强的选手逆风险率较大）的差异。与实力较弱的选手相比，实力较强的选手在赢者通吃的竞赛中选择更大的努力，在输者一无所有的竞赛中选择更小的努力。在具有多个相同奖项的竞赛中，努力排序可以是非单调的，并且在具有线性奖项结构的竞赛中，它们取决于选手概率密度函数的斜率。

articles.title_en: Revisiting “A theory of debt maturity and innovation” [J. Econ. Theory 218 (2024) 105828]
articles.title_cn: 重访“债务期限与创新理论”[J. Econ. Theory 218 (2024) 105828]
articles.abstract_en: We reconsider the incomplete contracting framework of Mitkov (2024) in which an entrepreneur seeks funding for a project and can privately choose its type. Renegotiation is permitted at an intermediate date. We characterize the conditions under which pay-for-failure is necessary to incentivize the entrepreneur to undertake the value-maximizing innovative project. When pay-for-failure is necessary, we generalize Mitkov (2024)’s results by showing that callable long-term debt can replicate the state-contingent contract for a strictly positive measure of parameters, and hence, we provide a rationale for its use in this setting.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们重新考虑了Mitkov（2024）的不完全契约框架，在该框架中，企业家寻求项目融资，并可以私下选择项目类型。在中间日期允许重新谈判。我们刻画了在何种条件下，失败支付对于激励企业家承担价值最大化的创新项目是必要的。当失败支付是必要时，我们推广了Mitkov（2024）的结果，表明可赎回的长期债务可以在严格正的参数测度下复制状态依存的契约，因此，我们为其在此环境中的使用提供了合理性依据。

articles.title_en: Strengthening incentives for truth-telling in Majority voting
articles.title_cn: 强化多数投票中真实表达的激励
articles.abstract_en: All currently known mechanisms that fully implement Majority rule are either infinite (integer games) or rely on off-equilibrium transfers. We propose a finite mechanism with no transfers, called Bloc formation, that achieves this goal in pure and mixed strategies. It increases the set of instances where any agent is pivotal by relying on off-equilibrium lotteries, and thus, incentivizes truth-telling.
articles.abstract_cn: 所有目前已知的能完全实施多数规则的机制要么是无限的（整数博弈），要么依赖于非均衡转移支付。我们提出了一种无转移支付的有限机制，称为集团形成，该机制在纯策略和混合策略中实现了这一目标。它通过依赖非均衡抽签扩大了任何代理人成为关键行动者的情形集合，从而激励了真实表达。

articles.title_cn: 选秀规则的公理化刻画
articles.abstract_en: Drafts are sequential round-robin allocation procedures for distributing heterogeneous and indivisible objects among agents subject to some priority order (e.g., allocating players’ contract rights to teams in professional sports leagues). Agents report ordinal preferences over objects and bundles are partially ordered by pairwise comparison. We provide a simple characterization of draft rules: they are the only allocation rules that are respectful of a priority (RP), envy-free up to one object (EF1), non-wasteful (NW), and resource monotonic (RM). RP and EF1 are crucial for competitive balance in sports leagues. We also prove two related impossibility theorems showing that the competitive-balance axioms RP and EF1 are generally incompatible with strategy-proofness. Nevertheless, draft rules satisfy maxmin strategy-proofness. If agents may declare some objects unacceptable, then draft rules are characterized by RP, EF1, NW, and RM, in conjunction with individual rationality and truncation invariance.
articles.abstract_cn: 选秀是按顺序循环分配的程序，用于在受某种优先顺序约束的代理人之间分配异质且不可分割的物品（例如，在职业体育联盟中将球员的合同权利分配给球队）。代理人报告对物品的序数偏好，并通过两两比较对组合进行偏序排序。我们提供了选秀规则的一个简单刻画：它们是唯一同时尊重优先顺序（RP）、至多一个物品的无嫉妒性（EF1）、非浪费性（NW）和资源单调性（RM）的分配规则。RP和EF1对于体育联盟中的竞争平衡至关重要。我们还证明了两个相关的不可能性定理，表明竞争平衡公理RP和EF1通常与策略防止性不相容。然而，选秀规则满足最大最小策略防止性。如果代理人可以声明某些物品不可接受，那么选秀规则由RP、EF1、NW和RM，连同个体理性和截断不变性共同刻画。

articles.title_cn: 专家意见分歧时的谨慎态度
articles.abstract_en: Experts often disagree. A decision-maker may want to be cautious and prefer alternatives that have expert consensus over those that do not. Existing models of decision making under expert disagreement rest on ambiguity-averse preferences adopting a unanimity principle: If all experts consider one choice better than another, so should the decision-maker. Such unanimity among experts, however, can be spurious, masking substantial disagreement on the underlying reasons. We introduce a novel notion of cautiousness to distinguish spurious from genuine unanimity and develop a model that can capture cautiousness in our sense. The central element of our model is the cautious aggregation of experts’ beliefs.
articles.abstract_cn: 专家们常常意见不一。决策者可能希望保持谨慎，倾向于选择那些获得专家共识的备选方案，而非那些缺乏共识的方案。现有的关于专家意见分歧下的决策模型依赖于采用一致性原则的模糊厌恶偏好：如果所有专家都认为一个选择优于另一个，那么决策者也应如此。然而，专家之间的这种一致性可能是虚假的，掩盖了在根本原因上的重大分歧。我们引入了一种新颖的谨慎概念，以区分虚假的一致性与真正的一致性，并开发了一个能够捕捉我们意义上谨慎态度的模型。我们模型的核心要素是对专家信念的谨慎聚合。

articles.title_en: Meta-preference, endogenous preference formation and dynamic choice
articles.title_cn: 元偏好、内生偏好形成与动态选择
articles.abstract_en: In a dynamic environment, this paper builds a model of layers of meta-preferences which explains endogenous preference formation as a consequence of subjective judgment by the decision maker’s current self about welfare of her successor self. The model allows us to describe how much the decision maker is willing to pay for investment in her preference formation. The paper provides a recursive utility representation of the layers of meta-preferences and applies it to the problems of investment in time preference and taste.
articles.abstract_cn: 在动态环境中，本文构建了一个多层元偏好模型，将内生偏好形成解释为决策者当前自我对其继任自我福利的主观判断结果。该模型使我们能够描述决策者愿意为其偏好形成投资支付多少。本文提供了多层元偏好的递归效用表示，并将其应用于时间偏好和品味投资问题。

articles.abstract_en: A sender seeks hard evidence to persuade a receiver to accept a project by designing a quality test. Testing is imperfectly reliable and produces evidence only with some probability. If the sender obtains the evidence, she can choose to disclose it or pretend not to have obtained it. When reliability is low, in equilibrium the sender chooses a pass/fail test that reveals only whether the quality is above or below a threshold. The pass/fail threshold is decreasing in reliability. If the sender can also commit to test design, the structure of the equilibrium test is the same, except that the pass/fail threshold is lower and increasing in reliability. The ability to commit to test design does not affect the outcome when reliability is high, but hurts the receiver otherwise. In an extension of the model in which the sender also chooses reliability, we provide sufficient conditions for the emergence of pass/fail tests.
articles.abstract_cn: 发送者寻求硬证据，通过设计质量测试来说服接收者接受项目。测试并非完全可靠，且仅以一定概率产生证据。如果发送者获得了证据，她可以选择披露或假装未获得。当可靠性较低时，在均衡中发送者会选择一种通过/失败测试，该测试仅揭示质量是否高于或低于某个阈值。通过/失败阈值随可靠性递减。如果发送者还能承诺测试设计，均衡测试的结构相同，只是通过/失败阈值更低且随可靠性递增。承诺测试设计的能力在可靠性高时不影响结果，但在其他情况下损害接收者。在模型的一个扩展中，发送者还选择可靠性，我们为通过/失败测试的出现提供了充分条件。

articles.title_en: Portfolio choice and settlement frictions: A theory of endogenous convenience yields
articles.title_cn: 投资组合选择与结算摩擦：内生便利收益的理论
articles.abstract_en: We study settlement frictions that arise from the need to finance negative balances through an over-the-counter (OTC) market. We derive a closed-form expression for the endogenous convenience yield and show how it can be incorporated into a canonical portfolio problem. Using this framework, we examine how shifts in settlement frictions affect liquidity premia, the volume of overnight funding, the dispersion of market rates, and optimal portfolio allocations. From a normative perspective, we show that in the competitive equilibrium, investors may either over- or under-invest in liquid assets; moreover, both higher risk aversion and tighter aggregate liquidity increase the likelihood of under-accumulation. Finally, we apply our framework to monetary policy implementation, showing that the transition from an abundant to a merely ample reserve regime can produce sharp movements in interbank rates.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了因需要通过场外交易（OTC）市场为负余额融资而产生的结算摩擦。我们推导出内生便利收益的闭式表达式，并展示了如何将其纳入经典的投资组合问题。利用这一框架，我们考察了结算摩擦的变化如何影响流动性溢价、隔夜融资量、市场利率的离散度以及最优投资组合配置。从规范角度看，我们表明在竞争均衡中，投资者可能过度或不足投资于流动性资产；此外，更高的风险厌恶和更紧的总体流动性都会增加积累不足的可能性。最后，我们将框架应用于货币政策实施，表明从充裕到仅充足的准备金制度的转变可能导致银行间利率的剧烈波动。

articles.title_en: Self-insurance and market insurance substitutability: An established tenet reconsidered
articles.title_cn: 自我保险与市场保险的替代性：对既有原则的再思考
articles.abstract_en: We study the interaction between self-insurance and market insurance when accident losses are multivalued. We show that self-insurance and market insurance may be complementary when self-insurance expenses do not affect much the probability distribution of large losses and the loading factor is high. This contrasts sharply with the conclusion of Ehrlich and Becker (1972) who establish the substitutability between self-insurance and market insurance when the cost of an accident is single-valued.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了当事故损失为多值时自我保险与市场保险之间的相互作用。我们表明，当自我保险支出对重大损失的概率分布影响不大且附加费率较高时，自我保险与市场保险可能是互补的。这与Ehrlich和Becker（1972）的结论形成鲜明对比，他们在事故成本为单值的情况下确立了自我保险与市场保险之间的替代性。
